parameters.help_en: The ID of the template to filter. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 可选参数，指定筛选模板Id

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual studio template
parameters.name: studio_name

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
PageSize.description_zh: 单页显示应用的数量，默认值：10。取值范围：1~50

SubtitleConfig.description_en: The information about the virtual studio template

items.description_en: The information about the virtual studio template

BackgroundResourceId.description_en: The ID of the background material resource

BackgroundResourceUrl.description_en: The public URL of the background material. The URL must be accessible over the Internet. Specify this parameter or \`BackgroundResourceId\`
BackgroundResourceUrl.description_zh: 背景素材外部访问地址，需要保证公网可用，与BackgroundResourceId二选一即可

BackgroundType.description_en:
The type of the background material. Valid values: VOD, PIC, and LIVE.

VOD: a video-on-demand file.

PIC: an image.

LIVE: a live stream
BackgroundType.description_zh:
背景素材类型：VOD,PIC,LIVE 三选一

VOD, 点播视频文件
PIC，图片
LIVE，直播流

Description.description_en: The description of the virtual studio template

Height.description_en:
The height of the preview image, in pixels.

The resolution of the preview image (width × height) must be one of the following:

Landscape low definition (360p): 640 × 360

Portrait low definition (360p): 360 × 640

Landscape standard definition (480p): 854 × 480

Portrait standard definition (480p): 480 × 854

Landscape high definition (720p): 1280 × 720

Portrait high definition (720p): 720 × 1280

Landscape ultra-high definition (1080p): 1920 × 1080

Portrait ultra-high definition (1080p): 1080 × 1920
Height.description_zh:
预览画面高度，单位：px

预览画面宽度x高度仅支持以下规格：          
横屏流畅 360P 640x360 
竖屏流畅 360P 360x640
横屏标清 480P 854x480
竖屏标清 480P 480x854
横屏高清 720P 1280x720
竖屏高清 720P 720x1280
横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080
竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920

MattingLayout.description_en: The layout of the keyed-out portrait
MattingLayout.description_zh: 多媒体素材位置布局信息

MattingType.description_en:
The chroma keying type for the source stream. This is used to process the ingested stream.

green: chroma keying for a portrait against a green screen background.

blue: chroma keying for a portrait against a blue screen background.

complex: chroma keying for a portrait against a real-world background
MattingType.description_zh:
源流抠图类型，对用户推流进行抠图处理

green 绿幕背景人像抠图
blue 蓝幕背景人像抠图
complex 实景人像抠图

MediaLayout.description_en: The layout information of the media asset

MediaResourceId.description_en: The ID of the VOD resource for the media asset

MediaResourceUrl.description_en: The URL of the media asset

MediaType.description_en:
The type of the media asset. Valid values: VOD, PIC, and LIVE.

VOD: a video-on-demand file.

PIC: an image.

LIVE: a live stream
MediaType.description_zh:
多媒体素材类型：VOD,PIC,LIVE 三选一


VOD, 点播视频文件
PIC，图片
LIVE，直播流

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the virtual studio template

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the virtual studio template. This parameter is the same as the \`StudioName\` parameter in the AddLiveAiStudio operation
TemplateName.description_zh: 虚拟演播模板名称。与AddLiveAiStudio中的StudioName参数相同

Width.description_en: The width of the preview image
